Name: LOT_RESULT_MAP_PATTERN_FLAG_ST
Description: Map pattern modifiers and their event flags, from the offline pattern lottery. Each row adds one modifier and its event flag to a pattern.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 42 rows.

Fields.Name: Pattern ID
Fields.Description: Map pattern this row belongs to. Every row of the pattern is applied when the pattern is used.

Fields.Name: Modifier Set
Fields.Description: LotBaseMapPatternFlag group this row was drawn from. Bookkeeping of the offline lottery; not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier the pattern has (Shifting Earth 10-15, events, site variants...). It joins the pattern's active modifiers. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that goes with the modifier for this pattern (e.g. 7600-7605 Shifting Earth, 8000-8011 buried treasure groups, 77xx day events). 0: none. A row with both Modifier and Event Flag 0 does nothing.

Fields.Name: Pattern Set ID
Fields.Description: MapPatternSet row the pattern belongs to. Bookkeeping of the offline lottery; not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Target Nightlord
Fields.Description: Nightlord of the pattern's set: 0 Gladius, 1 Adel, 2 Gnoster, 3 Maris, 4 Libra, 5 Fulghor, 6 Caligo, 7 Heolstor, 8 Harmonia, 9 Straghess. Bookkeeping of the offline lottery; not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Shifting Earth
Fields.Description: Shifting Earth of the pattern's set: 0 none, 1 Mountaintop, 2 The Crater, 3 Rotted Woods, 4 Great Hollow, 5 Shrouded City. Bookkeeping of the offline lottery; not read by the game.
